sustainability.title: Sustainability and Responsibility
sustainability.subtitle: Our commitment goes beyond hospitality: we protect the Amazon, value local communities and promote tourism that regenerates, not destroys.
sustainability.solarEnergyDesc: All our lodges are powered by solar energy, reducing our carbon footprint to zero.
sustainability.waterManagementDesc: Rainwater harvesting systems and biological wastewater treatment protect rivers and springs.
sustainability.zeroWasteDesc: Organic composting, total recycling and elimination of single-use plastics in all operations.
sustainability.localJobsDesc: 85% of our team is from the region, ensuring decent income and development of riverside communities.
sustainability.communitySupportDesc: Part of revenue funds education, health and income generation projects in local villages.
sustainability.forestConservationDesc: We protect 5,000 hectares of primary forest and support biodiversity research.
sustainability.missionText1: We believe tourism can be a positive force for environmental conservation and social development. Each guest we host contributes directly to protecting the Amazon rainforest and the well-being of traditional communities.
sustainability.missionText2: By choosing our lodges, you're not just experiencing something unforgettable — you're investing in the future of the Amazon and its people.

howToGetThere.title: How to Get There
howToGetThere.subtitle: The journey to our lodges is part of the Amazon experience. We offer multiple access options from Manaus and Belém.
howToGetThere.planeBoatDesc: Fly to Eduardo Gomes International Airport in Manaus (MAO). From there, our exclusive river transfer service takes you to the lodge in comfortable speedboats.
howToGetThere.riverCruiseDesc: For a more immersive experience, we offer packages that include navigation on regional boats, allowing you to appreciate the Amazonian landscape calmly and authentically.
howToGetThere.transferDesc: All our packages include transfer from airport/port to the lodge and vice versa. Our team will contact you after booking confirmation to coordinate schedules and logistical details.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to common questions about your stay

checkInTime.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkInTime.answer: Check-in: from 2 PM. Check-out: until 12 PM. For special times, contact us via WhatsApp.

vaccines.question: What vaccines are required?
vaccines.answer: We strongly recommend the yellow fever vaccine, applied at least 10 days before travel. Other vaccines like hepatitis A and tetanus are also recommended.

transfer.question: Do you offer transfer service?
transfer.answer: Yes! We offer transfer from Manaus airport to the lodge. The service must be scheduled in advance and has an additional cost.

cancellation.question: What is the cancellation policy?
cancellation.answer: Free cancellation up to 7 days before check-in. Between 3-7 days: 50% refund. Less than 3 days: no refund.

payment.question: What payment methods do you accept?
payment.answer: We accept credit card, debit card, PIX, and bank transfer. A 30% deposit is required to confirm the reservation.

amenities.question: What amenities are included?
amenities.answer: All accommodations include breakfast, Wi-Fi, bed and bath linens, air conditioning, and sustainable hygiene kit.

activities.question: What activities can I do?
activities.answer: We offer guided trails, canoe trips, bird watching, sport fishing, visits to riverside communities, and night expeditions.

contact.question: How can I contact you?
contact.answer: Contact us via WhatsApp: +55 92 8482-9983, phone: +55 92 3232-5050, or email: contato@pousadasamazonia.com

faq.contactUs: Contact us via WhatsApp and we'll be happy to help!
